title: Fizz Buzz
summary: 返回一到 n 的字符串序列，三的倍数写 Fizz、五的倍数写 Buzz、同时整除时写 FizzBuzz，其余写数字。
insight: 先判断十五的倍数可避免重叠分支，也可分别拼接两个词。
pitfalls: 十五的倍数必须输出组合词

solutions.title: 整除分类模拟
solutions.idea: 按十五、三、五、普通数字的优先级生成每一项。
steps: 加入对应字符串或十进制数字

code.java: class Solution { public List<String> fizzBuzz(int n){List<String> answer=new ArrayList<>();for(int value=1;value<=n;value++){if(value%15==0)answer.add("FizzBuzz");else if(value%3==0)answer.add("Fizz");else if(value%5==0)answer.add("Buzz");else answer.add(String.valueOf(value));}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun fizzBuzz(n:Int):List<String>{val answer=mutableListOf<String>();for(value in 1..n)answer.add(when{value%15==0->"FizzBuzz";value%3==0->"Fizz";value%5==0->"Buzz";else->value.toString()});return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: vector<string> fizzBuzz(int n){vector<string> answer;for(int value=1;value<=n;++value){if(value%15==0)answer.push_back("FizzBuzz");else if(value%3==0)answer.push_back("Fizz");else if(value%5==0)answer.push_back("Buzz");else answer.push_back(to_string(value));}return answer;} };
